subject: Lane B acceleration result; CPU-only while Lane A owns GPU
body: Lane B accepts current GPU serialization and will remain CPU-only until Lane A releases the lease. DeltaNet kernel qualification: FLA/Triton chunk gated-delta forward parity passed at seq 128/512 with max abs error <=0.0009765625 and warm forward speedups ~15.87x / ~13.30x. Backward parity at seq128 passed with output cosine 0.9999397 and Q/K/V/g/beta gradient cosines all >0.99993; warm backward was ~5-6 ms vs ~73 ms reference at seq128 and 6.24 ms vs 107.82 ms at seq512 (~17.27x median speedup at 512). torch.compile reference path spent ~141s compiling and was terminated/disqualified for this lane. Full-model probe attempt exposed that FLA causal_conv1d has a different tuple return contract; Lane B is NOT using that conv path. Safe candidate is FLA/Triton gated-delta + FLA fused norm with Qwen/Torch causal convolution. No optimizer step or weight mutation occurred.
